## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic completed routine photographic activity during March 2020. A total of 266 captures were recorded for the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. Activity was managed through the clinic’s usual operating arrangements, with no change to the reported monthly capture total.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally satisfactory. There were 6 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 2.3 per cent. These images could not be assessed reliably and were excluded from definitive grading. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for review, while the ungradable images should be considered in local quality monitoring and any subsequent review of capture practice.

## Grading

Grading identified 46 referable results. These results were recorded for appropriate onward consideration in line with the applicable clinical pathway. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This provides an overview of timeliness for the reporting period and should be read alongside the activity and image-quality measures above. Overall, the report records completed activity, a low level of ungradable images, and grading activity within the period.
